subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: Service With a Smile (Listening & Speaking)
lesson: Oman as a tourist destination; Listening 3.4.1: choosing a course
outcomes: Discuss Oman as a tourist destination and careers in tourism
Listen to a conversation about an events management course and choose answers

tf.s: Over a million tourists visit Oman every year.
tf.why: Oman is a popular tourist destination.

tf.s: An events management course teaches planning, designing and organising events.
tf.why: Events managers plan and organise events from start to finish.

tf.s: The diploma course in the listening lasts four years.
tf.why: The diploma is two years; the degree takes four years.

tf.s: The four-year degree is with a partner institute in Ireland.
tf.why: The degree comes from the Dublin Institute of Technology.

tf.s: The tutor says the degree only lets you work in Oman.
tf.why: The tutor says the degree lets you work anywhere in the world.

tf.s: Conferences, festivals and exhibitions are all kinds of events.
tf.why: Events managers can organise all of these.

tf.s: A degree usually takes longer to finish than a diploma.
tf.why: In the listening, the diploma is two years and the degree is four.

tf.s: A tourist destination is a place where tourists work in factories.
tf.why: A tourist destination is a place tourists travel to and visit.

tf.s: Reading the statements before listening helps you predict information.
tf.why: Prediction prepares you for what you will hear.

tf.s: A part-time course means you study every hour of every day.
tf.why: Part-time means you study for only part of the day or week.
